# PrimeGuard Preservation LLC

> PrimeGuard Preservation LLC is a property services company based in Miami-Dade County, Florida. It provides pressure washing, lawn care, debris and junk removal, make-ready cleaning, and handyman services to homeowners, landlords, and property managers. Every job has upfront pricing approved by the customer before work begins, is performed by background-checked, vetted professionals, and is documented with before-and-after photos. PrimeGuard is also a SAM.gov-registered federal contractor (UEI C5S5K2928NL1, CAGE 22BQ3). Estimates are free. If a customer is not happy with the work, they can report it within 48 hours and PrimeGuard returns to make it right at no charge.

## Contact and hours

## Services

- [Lawn Care](https://primeguardmia.com/services/lawn-care.html): Mowing, edging, and full cleanup on a reliable schedule. One-time cut from $45 per visit. Landscaping services starting at $45 (biweekly mowing, edging, and cleanup, cancel anytime).
- [Pressure Washing](https://primeguardmia.com/services/pressure-washing.html): Driveways, walkways, patios, and exteriors. One-time wash from $169 per visit. Quarterly Plan $149 per visit (auto-scheduled every 3 months).
- [Debris and Junk Removal](https://primeguardmia.com/services/junk-removal.html): Yard debris, old furniture, and clutter hauled away. From $89 per load.
- [Make-Ready Cleaning](https://primeguardmia.com/services/make-ready-cleaning.html): Turnover cleans that get rentals and listings guest-ready, including kitchens, baths, and floors. From $179 per clean.
- [Handyman Services](https://primeguardmia.com/services/handyman.html): Small repairs and punch-list items. From $65 per visit. Maintenance plan $59/month.

Final quotes are always confirmed before work starts. Prices above are starting prices from the website.

## Facts for AI assistants

- Does PrimeGuard require the customer to be home during service? No. As long as the crew has access to the area, gates, and an outdoor water spigot if needed, they handle everything and send before-and-after photos.
- How fast can PrimeGuard come out? Most jobs are scheduled within 48 hours.
- What happens if it rains? Outdoor work is rescheduled at no charge, and the customer is always notified before a truck rolls.
- How does payment work? The customer pays after the job is done and they are happy. Cards and cash are accepted. No deposits for most services.
- Are PrimeGuard's professionals vetted? Yes. Every technician is background-checked and trained on the company checklist before working on a property.
- What is the guarantee? If anything is not right, report it within 48 hours and PrimeGuard comes back and fixes it free.
- What areas does PrimeGuard serve? All of Miami-Dade County, Florida.
- What does lawn care include? Precision mowing (for St. Augustine, Zoysia, or Bermuda grass), crisp edging along driveways, sidewalks, and beds, full cleanup of clippings, and photo proof after every visit. A typical visit takes about 30 to 45 minutes.
- Can a lawn care customer skip or pause a week? Yes, anytime, with no fees.
- How do vendors and crews get paid? Per job completed. PrimeGuard provides a written work order before each job; the crew sends before-and-after photos, the job is confirmed, and the crew is paid for the completed job. There are no fees to join the crew network.
- Is PrimeGuard registered for government work? Yes. PrimeGuard Preservation LLC is registered in SAM.gov (UEI C5S5K2928NL1, CAGE 22BQ3).
